lastChange.note: T4 (issue #171): PopoverMenu is built in bundle.js as a positioned panel (no popover API, no CSS anchor positioning). It reuses the Tooltip's panel helpers (placePanel gains start alignment and a viewport clamp for the menu), moves into the nearest open dialog that holds its anchor or the page body, and is placed against the anchor and flipped inside the viewport. New props: id (on the role=menu element, for the trigger's aria-controls), anchor (a ref to the trigger, read only to place the menu and return focus) and singleKeys (P as a Kbd in the heading row; the host adds P to the trigger's aria-keyshortcuts). The host sets the trigger's aria-expanded and aria-controls. Radio, checkbox and link rows; arrows move, Return or Space chooses and closes, Esc or Tab closes and returns focus to the trigger; read-only keeps link rows live. Tooltip shows nothing while its child has aria-expanded true, so Esc in an open menu closes the menu. README, preview (both themes, read-only, Focus window, checkbox rows, inside an open Dialog) and index.d.ts updated.
